scope: Two fully declared literature-motivated five-session refits; not exact published probability or return replications
fit_reference: R2-COMPARISON.json#/logit_fit_shared gives the fixed native implementation, target/horizon, train-only transformations and failure states

primary_source.accessible_version: Author-hosted February2013preprint, linked under2014JFEarticle; UNC explicitly labels editionPreprint
primary_source.limits: Final2014method equivalence and printed coefficient scaling are not established. No table coefficients or historical OOS probabilities are reused.

CKX.native_literature_contract: Eight-variable logistic model of next12-month continuously compounded return>1.00, with delisting returns. End-June annual estimation expands from1951with at least20years, accounting lag6months, predictors winsorized5/95. This is not the same target, sample length or cadence as N1.
CKX.fixed_N1_adaptation: Use exactly the eight supported predictor families below, with declared daily historical operators, and refit native binary logit on the commonN1close-based+100percent-within5session target using2022-2023only. No claim that this is CKX's calibrated annual jackpot probability.

predictors.RET12: Sum of log total-wealth daily returns whose session date is in(a minus12calendar months,a], using date-offset months, not an approximated252-row year. Wealth includes verified dividends/delisting proceeds and consistent share basis; missing economic adjustments reject the row.
predictors.STDEV: SampleSD(ddof1) of daily log total-wealth returns in(a minus3calendar months,a], expressed as raw return fraction. Train-fold centering/scaling replaces ambiguous printed-table units.
predictors.SKEW: Adjusted Fisher-Pearson sample skewness of those same3-month daily log returns; known zero dispersion maps to0
predictors.TURN: Mean monthly share turnover over the last6completecalendar months minus mean over the last18completecalendar months before decision_t. Each month's turnover=sum daily volume/shares_outstanding in the same cutoff-consistent share units; original dated shares required.
predictors.SIZE: ln(split-consistent anchor_close*original as-of shares_outstanding/1000), USD market cap in thousands
predictors.AGE: Calendar days since the earliest admitted original listing start for this immutable security divided by365.25; original lifetime evidence is required, not first date in the downloaded sample. This is the declared available-security-master adaptation of the paper's firstCRSPappearance operator.
predictors.TANG: Original annual grossPPE/total_assets from the latest fiscal-year record actually disseminated by cutoff and whose fiscal-year-end precedes cutoff by at least6calendar months; positive assets required
predictors.SALESGRTH: ln(Sales_y/Sales_y-1) from those original consecutive annual records, same availability and6-month lag. Nonpositive/missing sales or revision history is unknown, not0.

CKX.local_choices_declared: Daily sample/target, explicit log-return convention, sample skewness/ddof, daily availability, listing-date mapping, calendar-month windows and native optimizer are fixed local adaptations. They are not silently attributed to the paper.
CKX.required_data: Historical total-wealth prices/actions/terminal entitlements, dated shares, listing lifetimes and original accounting versions. Unavailable data makes the mandatory comparison INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never a seven-variable replacement.

primary_concept.locators: Public introduction lines119 and121: left/right option-implied tails from Bollerslev/Todorov2011, option-implied volatility and realized-versus-implied-volatility difference predict jumps OOS
primary_concept.native_label: Absolute idiosyncratic return>3conditional idiosyncratic standard deviations; not theN1+100percent close label
primary_concept.horizon_limit: Public nextday/week/month wording describes portfolio return evaluation; it is not proof of a native probability horizon. Native KZlogit/tenor/optimizer is not asserted from this preview.

primary_operator_source.title: Tails, Fears, and Risk Premia
primary_operator_source.operator_definition: RTQ_t(k) approximately exp(integrated_r)*C_t(K)/(tau*F_tminus); LTQ_t(k) approximately exp(integrated_r)*P_t(K)/(tau*F_tminus); k=ln(K/F_tminus)
primary_operator_source.semantic_limit: These are annualized normalized tailPAYOFF measures, not automatically probabilities in[0,1]. Do not relabel them as calibrated jump probabilities.
primary_operator_source.notation_resolution: Primarycaption/body conflict over 'log-moneyness'. This adaptation explicitly uses strikeRATIOS0.9and1.1 and k=ln(ratio), never logk0.9/1.1.

KZ.fixed_N1_adaptation: A NEW binary five-session logit over the three supported predictor classes, using the exact tail/volatility operators below. It is named KZ-tail-inspired refit, not a replication of unidentified original logit coefficients or probability horizon. It is mandatory in the common-cohort comparison.

option_selection.observation: Original options snapshot at the completed anchor_a close, demonstrated available by_q_t; current reconstructed chain or future intraday quote is forbidden
option_selection.expiry: Earliest standard listed expiry with at least8calendar days remaining after_a; no maturity chosen from future return or quality of fit
option_selection.price: Supported original positive finite two-sided midpoint=(bid+ask)/2, same timestamp/expiry for selected call/put, executable-spread metadata retained
option_selection.forward: Original verified same-expiry forward/futures-equivalentF and integrated riskfree rate for that tenor from qualified sources; missingF/r is unknown. No current-rate substitution.
option_selection.target_strikes: K_L=0.9F for OTMput, K_R=1.1F for OTMcall; bracket each target with two listed strikes and linearly interpolate their Black-Scholes implied volatilities, then use the supportedBS pricing operator at the target strike
option_selection.interpolation: No extrapolation or deepest-strike proxy. Missing bracketing quotes excludes the common row. Use installed NautilusTrader2.0.0rc5 imply_vol and black_scholes_greeks; native input/output signatures are bound below. No new dependency, locally rebuilt pricing formula or solver.
option_selection.tau: Remaining XNYS trading sessions including expiry, counted from_a using the frozen calendar, divided by252; retain exact calendar and maturity timestamps
option_selection.IV_ATM: Annualized fractional implied vol for the same expiry atK=F, interpolated by the same qualified upstream operator; no mixing tenor or percent units
option_selection.exercise_style: Require European exercise or originally archived European-equivalent premium/IV with supported exercise/dividend conversion and version provenance. Raw American equity mids without that equivalence are unqualified; no local guessed early-exercise adjustment.
option_selection.native_pricing_mapping: nautechsystems/nautilus_trader@1b0a49d2792a9432a3aca3fcb617ce7a630d905e: nautilus_trader.model.imply_vol(s=F,r=integrated_r/tau,b=0,is_call=is_call,k=K,t=tau,price=qualified_mid) at each bracketing strike. Linear-IV interpolate to targetK; black_scholes_greeks(s=F,r=integrated_r/tau,b=0,vol=interpolated_vol,is_call=is_call,k=targetK,t=tau).price. Sources crates/model/src/data/greeks.rs:193-226 and python/data/greeks.rs:275-306; native signatures verified, no pricing/model fit run. This generalizedBSforward mapping is the declared European-equivalent implementation, not an assertion that raw American quotes fit that model.
option_selection.numeric_admission: FinitepositiveF/tau/premium and finiteinterest/vol; IVmust befinitepositive. Native imply_vol returns0onfailure; reject0rather than using safe-vol fallback. Native greeks pricing internally usesf32; require premium-roundtrip absolute error<=max(original source premium_tick,0.000001*max(1,premium)) and record error. Nonfinite/nonconverged/incompatible style inputs yield INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than a fallback solver.

predictors.RV_MINUS_IV: sqrt252*sampleSD(ddof1) of preceding20complete daily log total-wealth returns ending_a minus_IV_ATM, both annualized fractions. The20-session lookback and realized-minus-implied orientation are explicitly local choices, not inferred KZparameters.

KZ.fitting: Exactly R2-COMPARISON.json logit_fit_shared: binary commonN1five-session target, training-only5/95winsorization and scaling, unpenalized nativeLBFGSfit, no copied paper weights
KZ.required_data: Qualified original compatible options quotes/tenor/forward/rate and historical total-wealth returns. Owner-held OPRA/other paid-option data is not acquired by this document task. Missing data or identity prevents execution/promotion; the arm is never silently replaced by a genericprice-volume logit.
KZ.method_distinction: KZpublicpreview supports the predictor classes; BTprimarysource supplies computational tailoperators; concrete orientation/lookback/fit/target/no-extrapolation rules are declared pre-outcome research adaptations. Both readers must approve this exact adaptation scope before freeze.

mandatory_comparison_rule: Both literature arms are specified and required. No absence of a paid input, native method equivalence, convergence or sample eligibility can be hidden by leaving the comparator unevaluated and declaring main-model success. Preserve INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE until all mandatory arms execute under this frozen contract.
